Dictation

1. Pick a line

The line is the same one Reading Benchmarks asks you to play, but here you don't see it: you hear it and write it down. You're given the meter, the key and the number of bars.

2. Listen and write

The Notation page opens in its own window, set up with the meter and key (your own piece there is kept, untouched). Write the line there, then press Hand in. Hear it again there plays it from here. Plays so far: 0.

3. Result

Nothing handed in yet.
